source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia

country.match: Match each drink to the country it comes from.
country.odd: Three of these drinks come from {value}. Which one doesn't?

made_from.match: Match each drink to what it's made from.

kind.odd: Three of these are {value}s. Which one isn't?

exclude.why: Absinthe: Switzerland and France both claim it - origin argued
Lager: a brewing style shared across Central Europe - no single country
Raki: an anise spirit claimed across Turkey and the Balkans

rows.label: Matcha
rows.hook: is a finely ground powdered leaf whisked into hot water for a vivid, ceremonial drink

rows.label: Absinthe
rows.hook: is a strong bitter spirit flavored with an herb once wrongly blamed for causing hallucinations

rows.label: Negroni
rows.description: cocktail made of gin, Campari, and vermouth
rows.hook: is a bright red bittersweet cocktail served over ice with an orange twist

rows.label: Long Island iced tea
rows.description: mixed drink with vodka, gin, tequila, and rum
rows.hook: is a mixed cocktail combining four clear spirits with cola for a deceptively strong drink

rows.label: Bubble tea
rows.description: Taiwanese tea-based drink containing tapioca pearls
rows.hook: is a milky sweet drink served cold with chewy tapioca balls sipped through a wide straw

rows.label: Paloma
rows.hook: is a citrusy cocktail topped with grapefruit soda and served in a salt-rimmed glass

rows.label: Root beer
rows.description: carbonated beverage, originally made using the root of a sassafras plant
rows.hook: is a sweet fizzy soda historically flavored with a fragrant tree bark blend

rows.label: Piña colada
rows.description: sweet, rum-based cocktail with coconut and pineapple
rows.hook: is a creamy, sweet cocktail blended with pineapple and coconut cream

rows.label: Soju
rows.hook: is a clear, mild-tasting distilled spirit traditionally sipped from small shot glasses

rows.label: Bourbon
rows.description: type of American whiskey, a barrel-aged distilled spirit made primarily from corn
rows.hook: is a caramel-colored spirit aged in charred oak barrels, giving it a sweet, smoky flavor

rows.label: Martini
rows.description: cocktail made with gin and vermouth
rows.hook: is a classic cocktail stirred or shaken and garnished with an olive or a lemon twist

rows.label: Old fashioned
rows.description: cocktail made of sugar with bitters and alcohol
rows.hook: is a spirit-forward cocktail muddled with a sugar cube and a few dashes of bitters

rows.label: Cognac
rows.hook: is a smooth amber spirit double-distilled and aged in oak, sipped from a wide-bowled glass

rows.label: Spritz
rows.hook: is a bubbly, low-alcohol drink poured over ice and topped with soda water

rows.label: Espresso
rows.description: strong type of coffee made using hot water under pressure
rows.hook: is a small, concentrated shot of dark roast topped with a thin layer of golden crema

rows.label: Mai Tai
rows.description: cocktail based on rum, Curaçao liqueur and lime juice
rows.hook: is a tiki cocktail with a nutty almond-syrup sweetness, garnished with a mint sprig and lime shell

rows.label: Bloody Mary
rows.description: cocktail containing vodka and tomato juice
rows.hook: is a savory brunch cocktail mixed with tomato juice and spices, garnished with celery

rows.label: Margarita
rows.description: Mexican cocktail of tequila and orange liqueur
rows.hook: is a lime-based cocktail served on the rocks or blended, often in a salt-rimmed glass

rows.label: Tequila
rows.hook: is a spirit distilled from the heart of a spiky desert plant and often served with lime and salt

rows.label: Cortado
rows.description: beverage consisting of espresso mixed with a roughly equal amount of warm milk to reduce the acidity
rows.hook: is a small espresso-based drink cut with a bit of warm milk to soften its bite

rows.label: Sake
rows.hook: is a clear fermented drink brewed from a staple grain and traditionally served warm or chilled

rows.label: Port
rows.hook: is a sweet fortified wine traditionally enjoyed after dinner

rows.label: Mezcal
rows.hook: is a smoky spirit distilled from a roasted desert plant, often sipped neat

rows.label: Limoncello
rows.hook: is a bright yellow sweet liqueur served ice-cold as a after-dinner sipper

rows.label: Moscow mule
rows.description: mule cocktail with vodka, ginger beer and lime
rows.hook: is a spicy, citrusy cocktail traditionally served in a copper mug

rows.label: Rooibos
rows.hook: is a naturally caffeine-free reddish herbal infusion brewed from a needle-leafed shrub

rows.label: Rakı
rows.hook: is a strong anise spirit that turns milky white when water is added, often served with grilled meats

rows.label: Earl Grey
rows.description: black tea blend flavored with bergamot
rows.hook: is a leaf infusion scented with a citrusy oil from a small orange-like fruit

rows.label: Ouzo
rows.hook: is a licorice-flavored spirit that turns milky with water or ice, often sipped alongside seafood

rows.label: Masala chai
rows.description: flavoured tea beverage made from milk, aromatic spices and herbs
rows.hook: is a spiced, milky brewed drink warmed with cinnamon, cardamom and other spices

rows.label: Caipirinha
rows.hook: is a muddled cocktail of crushed limes and sugar over a strong sugarcane spirit

rows.label: Cappuccino
rows.hook: is an espresso-based drink topped with a thick layer of steamed milk foam

rows.label: Cachaça
rows.hook: is a distilled spirit made from fresh pressed cane juice rather than molasses

rows.label: India pale ale
rows.description: Pale ale beer with high hop content to improve its preservation
rows.hook: is a heavily hopped, bitter beer originally brewed extra strong to survive long sea voyages

rows.label: Cosmopolitan
rows.hook: is a pink cocktail served in a chilled glass with a splash of cranberry and citrus

rows.label: Baijiu
rows.description: Chinese liquor distilled from sorghum, rice, wheat, barley, millet, or Job's tears; name means literally “white alcohol”
rows.hook: is an intensely strong, pungent clear grain spirit sipped in tiny cups during toasts

rows.label: Prosecco
rows.description: Italian controlled designation of origin wine from Veneto and Friuli-Venezia Giulia
rows.hook: is a light, bubbly wine often used as the base for a popular brunch cocktail

rows.label: Champagne
rows.hook: is a bubbly celebratory wine made using a special two-step fermentation process

rows.label: Amaretto
rows.hook: is a sweet nutty liqueur with a rich marzipan-like flavor

rows.label: Cola
rows.hook: is a dark, fizzy, caramel-colored soft drink historically flavored with a tropical nut

rows.label: Sherry
rows.description: fortified wine made from white grapes
rows.hook: is a fortified wine ranging from bone dry to lusciously sweet, often sipped before or after a meal

rows.label: Mojito
rows.hook: is a minty, sugary cocktail topped with soda water and muddled fresh leaves

rows.label: Grappa
rows.hook: is a fiery clear spirit distilled from the leftover skins, seeds and stems after winemaking

rows.label: Oolong
rows.hook: is a partially oxidized leaf infusion that falls between a green and a dark variety in flavor

rows.label: Manhattan
rows.description: cocktail made with whiskey, sweet vermouth, and bitters
rows.hook: is a stirred cocktail of a dark spirit and sweet vermouth, garnished with a cherry

rows.label: Sangria
rows.hook: is a fruity chilled punch made by mixing chopped fruit into a red or white base

rows.label: Sambuca
rows.hook: is a syrupy-sweet liqueur with a licorice-like flavor, sometimes served flaming with coffee beans on top

rows.label: White Russian
rows.description: cocktail made with vodka and coffee liqueur
rows.hook: is a creamy after-dinner cocktail layered with a coffee liqueur and topped with cream

rows.label: Daiquiri
rows.description: family of cocktails with with rum, citrus and some sweetener
rows.hook: is a chilled, citrusy cocktail shaken with a clear cane spirit and a touch of sweetener

rows.label: Pu'er
rows.description: variety of fermented tea produced in the Yunnan province of China
rows.hook: is a dark, earthy fermented leaf infusion often pressed into aged cakes or bricks

rows.label: Ayran
rows.description: drink made from yoghurt with soda water and salt, and sometimes also vodka
rows.hook: is a savory, salted, watered-down cultured milk drink served chilled

rows.label: Pilsner
rows.hook: is a golden, clear beer style that broke from the cloudy, dark beers common before it

rows.label: Agua fresca
rows.hook: is a light, non-fizzy drink blended from melon, hibiscus or tamarind with water and a little sweetener

rows.label: Mimosa
rows.description: drink composed of sparkling wine and citrus fruit juice
rows.hook: is a brunch cocktail that mixes a bubbly drink with citrus juice in equal parts

rows.label: Lager
rows.hook: is a beer style fermented and matured at cold temperatures for a clean, crisp taste

rows.label: Bellini
rows.description: cocktail of Prosecco sparkling wine and peach purée
rows.hook: is a peach-flavored cocktail made with a light bubbly wine, traditionally a pale pink color

rows.label: Macchiato
rows.description: espresso coffee drink with a small amount of milk, usually foamed
rows.hook: is a small espresso-based drink marked with just a dollop of foamed milk

rows.label: Lapsang souchong
rows.description: Chinese black tea that is smoke-dried
rows.hook: is a leaf infusion dried over smoldering pine, giving it a campfire aroma

rows.label: Ristretto
rows.hook: is an extra-short, extra-concentrated espresso shot pulled with less water

rows.label: Ginger beer
rows.hook: is a spicy, fizzy soft drink brewed or flavored with a hot fibrous root

rows.label: Armagnac
rows.description: style of brandy produced in France
rows.hook: is an amber spirit distilled once and aged in oak, sipped after a meal

rows.label: Frappé coffee
rows.hook: is a cold, foamy shaken drink made from instant grounds and served over ice

rows.label: Chianti
rows.description: Italian controlled and guaranteed designation of origin wine from Tuscany
rows.hook: is a dry red table wine known for its distinctive straw-wrapped bottle

rows.label: Madeira
rows.hook: is a fortified wine cooked with gentle heat, which lets it stay fresh long after opening

rows.label: Calvados
rows.hook: is a spirit distilled from fermented cider and aged in oak casks

rows.label: Makgeolli
rows.hook: is a milky, lightly fizzy fermented grain drink with a slightly sweet tang

rows.label: Burgundy
rows.description: wine made in the Burgundy region in eastern France
rows.hook: is a red or white wine traditionally made from a single grape variety, rather than blended

rows.label: Bordeaux
rows.hook: is a red or white wine traditionally blended from several grape varieties grown near a coastal port
